name: New Jersey Quiet Championship 2024

venue.name: [Princeton University](http://www.princeton.edu/)
venue.address: Frist Campus Center, Frist Ln, Princeton, NJ 08544

information: This competition is a part of New Jersey Championship 2024 as a separate competition with ***only quiet events.*** The podium as well as the New Jersey Champion will be receiving awards at the main competition. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.
